doc: roles — what a semantic node is. The set aligns with ARIA and AccessKit (`aria`, `accesskit` give the mapping a platform accessibility layer uses). `interactive` roles must have a name (S-6) and should have an explicit id. Append-only: the generated enum keeps this order.

role.name: none
role.doc: Not exposed: presentation only.

role.name: generic
role.doc: A container with no meaning of its own.

role.name: application
role.doc: The root of an application's interface.

role.name: window
role.doc: A top-level window.

role.name: dialog
role.doc: A dialog window.

role.name: alert_dialog
role.doc: A dialog that interrupts to report something urgent.

role.name: group
role.doc: A set of related elements.

role.name: region
role.doc: A significant section the user may want to jump to.

role.name: toolbar
role.doc: A row of controls.

role.name: separator
role.doc: A divider between groups of content.

role.name: text
role.doc: A run of static text.

role.name: heading
role.doc: A heading; `value` holds the level.

role.name: paragraph
role.doc: A paragraph of text.

role.name: label
role.doc: The label of another element.

role.name: link
role.doc: A reference to another resource; activating it has the `external` effect unless it stays in the application.

role.name: image
role.doc: An image; `name` is its text alternative.

role.name: figure
role.doc: A self-contained illustration with a caption.

role.name: button
role.doc: Performs an action when activated.

role.name: toggle_button
role.doc: A button with an on/off state.

role.name: checkbox
role.doc: A checkable option.

role.name: radio
role.doc: One option of a radio group.

role.name: radio_group
role.doc: A set of mutually exclusive options.

role.name: switch
role.doc: An on/off switch.

role.name: slider
role.doc: Chooses a value in a range by moving a thumb.

role.name: spin_button
role.doc: Chooses a value by stepping it.

role.name: progress
role.doc: Shows the progress of a task.

role.name: meter
role.doc: Shows a measurement within a known range.

role.name: text_box
role.doc: A text field.

role.name: search_box
role.doc: A text field for a search query.

role.name: combo_box
role.doc: A text field or button with a popup of choices.

role.name: list_box
role.doc: A list of selectable options.

role.name: option
role.doc: An option of a list box or combo box.

role.name: list
role.doc: A list of items.

role.name: list_item
role.doc: An item of a list.

role.name: menu
role.doc: A list of commands.

role.name: menu_bar
role.doc: A horizontal menu at the top of a window.

role.name: menu_item
role.doc: A command of a menu.

role.name: menu_item_checkbox
role.doc: A checkable command of a menu.

role.name: menu_item_radio
role.doc: One of exclusive commands of a menu.

role.name: tab_list
role.doc: The tabs of a tabbed view.

role.name: tab
role.doc: A tab; selecting it shows its panel.

role.name: tab_panel
role.doc: The content of a tab.

role.name: tooltip
role.doc: A popup describing an element.

role.name: tree
role.doc: A hierarchical list.

role.name: tree_item
role.doc: An item of a tree.

role.name: grid
role.doc: A table of interactive cells.

role.name: table
role.doc: A table of data.

role.name: row
role.doc: A row of a grid or table.

role.name: cell
role.doc: A cell of a grid or table.

role.name: column_header
role.doc: The header of a column.

role.name: row_header
role.doc: The header of a row.

role.name: scroll_view
role.doc: A scrollable viewport onto larger content.

role.name: scroll_bar
role.doc: Controls the position of a scroll view.

role.name: canvas
role.doc: A two-dimensional surface of positioned items (OMUI_EXT_canvas).

role.name: document
role.doc: A document: content to read rather than an application to operate.

role.name: article
role.doc: A self-contained composition within a document.

role.name: code
role.doc: Source code or other computer text.

role.name: status
role.doc: A live region reporting status.

role.name: timer
role.doc: A live region showing elapsed or remaining time.

role.name: video
role.doc: A video player.

role.name: splitter
role.doc: A movable divider between two panes.

role.name: disclosure
role.doc: Shows or hides a section of content.

role.name: timeline
role.doc: A time axis with a playhead (openmui-ui-timeline).

role.name: blockquote
role.doc: A section quoted from another source.

role.name: navigation
role.doc: A landmark: the links or places that move around the application or document.

role.name: main
role.doc: A landmark: the application's or document's main content (one per view).

role.name: log
role.doc: A live record of what happened, newest last (the actions another actor took, a chat): its new entries read out politely.
